paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: (left) and (right) of scaling up SFT dataset across various model scales in the LLaMA-2 family. The results suggest scaling up model scales and SFT dataset can further improve .

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-E percentages across different models and SFT conditions. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled as "CoLeG-E (%)" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 50 with tick intervals of 10. Each category contains four stacked bars differentiated by colors: light blue with white stripes, indicates "no SFT", orange with white horizontal lines, denotes "+ SFT on D₀", purple with white striped represents "+ SFT on D₀, D₁", and peach signifies "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂". For LLaMA-2-7B, the bars are approximately 4%, 20%, 28%, and 30% respectively. In LLaMA-2-13B, the values are 8%, 31%, 35%, and 37%. For LLaMA-2-70B, the bars reach 25%, 43%, 48%, and 50%. The bars are consistent in height with the pink bar in each category reaching the highest value. There is no specific sort order for the categories other than the labeled names, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the use of colors and patterns. A legend is given top left.
